questions: Have you noticed your eyelid drooping?
Does it get worse later in the day?
Do you have double vision?
Do you have any weakness in your arms or legs?
Have you had a bad headache recently?
Have you noticed any difference in sweating on one side of your face?
Has there been any pain around your eye or forehead?
Have you had any recent surgery or trauma to your chest or neck?
Did this start suddenly or gradually?
Have you noticed any change in pupil size?
Do you have pain when you chew food (jaw claudication)?
Is your scalp tender to touch?
Have you had any changes in your vision, like blurriness?
Do you feel fatigued or have unexplained weight loss?
Have you had any fever?
Do you have diabetes?
Do you have high blood pressure?
Are you a smoker?
Has anyone in your family had strokes or heart disease?
Have you had any recent infections or felt unwell before this started?
What kind of infection did you have? (cold, flu, sinus infection?)
Did the eyelid droop start during or after the infection?
Does the droopiness ever get better during the day or worse when you're tired?
Can you close your right eye tightly?
Have you had any numbness or tingling on your face?
Has the pain gotten better or worse since it started?
Can you see the red color of my glove equally well in both eyes?
Do you have any drooling or difficulty with facial expressions?
Has the pain gotten better or worse since it started? (clarify - better or worse?)
Which eye has worse vision - the right eye?
orders: Examine both pupils carefully - measure and compare sizes in light and dark
Check for reversal of pupillary dilation (tonic pupil response)
Examine extraocular movements in all directions
Test facial sensation in V1, V2, V3 distributions
Check for facial anhidrosis by observing sweat response on forehead after gentle warming
Ice pack test (place ice on closed right eyelid for 2 minutes, check for improvement in ptosis)
MRI brain with contrast (looking for brainstem lesion or demyelination)
Test color vision (Ishihara plates) in both eyes
Check visual acuity (Snellen chart) in both eyes formally
Trial of oral prednisone 1mg/kg/day for 5-7 days (diagnostic and therapeutic trial for Tolosa-Hunt syndrome)
